title: Roadmap to v2.0.0
body:
Now, Hono has become a great framework. It has much built-in middleware, fine DX, flexible routings, and high-performance routers. Then, the basic API design is fixed. But I think we have a lot of things to do with Hono yet.

We can support Deno and Bun. It's still just experimental. We can make it complete.

How about making third-party middleware. The coupling of [firebase-auth-cloudflare-workers](https://github.com/Code-Hex/firebase-auth-cloudflare-workers) seems good. Organizing current middleware, I'm planning separate the middleware that does not depend on other libraries and middleware that depends on other libraries such as *graphql-server* or *mustache*. To make it clean, how about making the `github.com/honojs/graphql-server` repository, and moving current code into that. Additionally, how about using `@honojs/graphql-server` namespace in the npm repository. I've already got the `honojs` org in npm repo.

And, I want to make `validator` middleware. That is what I want.

In this way, we have many things to do. So, I decided to implement almost things and release them as **v2.0.0**. Is it good? Listed what I want to do roughly below. If you have a feature request. Please write it in the comments.

---

- [x] Support *Deno* #351 
- [x] Test well on *Deno* #351 
- [x] CI for Deno #364 
- [x] Support *Bun* #344 
- [x] `serve-static` middleware for Bun
- [x] Test on Bun
- [x] ~~Make repository for middleware using third party libraries~~ #350 
- [x] ~~Move the middleware using third party libs in current repository to new repository~~ later #350
- [x] ~~Use `honojs` org on npm repository~~ later #350
- [x] ~~Make `@honojs/xxx` namespace~~ later  #350 
- [x] ~~`github.com/honojs/xxx` repository~~ later #350 
- [x] ~~Make `validator` middleware as builtin~~ later
- [x] ~~`firebase-auth` middleware as third party~~ later
- [x] ~~`prometheus` middleware as third party~~ later #263 
- [x] Remove `graphql-server` middleware from this repo #357 
- [x] Remove `mustache` middleware from this repo #354 
- [x] ~~Access privileges for github repo~~ later
- [x] ~~Access privileges for npm repos~~ later
- [x] Make `body-parse` into `Context`? #362 
- [x] Make `cookie` into Request/Reponse #353 
- [x] ~~Integrate `app.fetch` and `app.request`?~~
- [x] New middleware structure #350 
- [x] Documenation
- [x] Website
- [x] Migration guide
- [x] And, others

By the way, we don't have to implement all things.
